reason: I'd add it to one group and burn through the free 30, sure. But receipts come in every day across three or four groups, so 100 documents won't cover a month, and I'm not paying $35 or $79 every month for something my staff might stop feeding properly. I'd go back to the spreadsheet I already do myself.
objection: Once the free part is gone it's another monthly bill, and the price goes up with how many receipts we send. In a busy month I'm paying more for the same sheet, and I'm not sure my staff will keep sending everything through properly.
would_change_my_mind: One flat price under $20 a month for all my groups with no document limit, and seeing in the free month that the sheet was right without me fixing it.
